name: getQualificationClassification
description: Retrieves qualification classification records from the system by code, name, or as a full list. Supports partial matching and can return either summary data or detailed records. Also handles “get all/available/existing qualifications” requests using fetchMode.

basic.name: getQualificationClassification
basic.description: Retrieves qualification classification records from the system by code, name, or as a full list. Supports partial matching and can return either summary data or detailed records. Also handles “get all/available/existing qualifications” requests using fetchMode.

args.name: classificationCode
args.description: Use the provided classification code to search and return the corresponding qualification classification details.

args.name: classificationName
args.description: Use the provided classification name to search and return the corresponding qualification classification details.

args.name: includeDetails
args.description: If true, fetches detailed info for each match. Default: false

args.name: fetchMode
args.description: Returns all qualification classifications instead of searching by code or name. Use values like "ALL", "AVAILABLE", "EXISTING", or "LIST" when the user asks for all or available qualifications. If set, code/name filters are ignored.

args.name: returnAll
args.description: Returns all qualification classifications instead of searching by code or name. Use values like "ALL", "AVAILABLE", "EXISTING", or "LIST" when the user asks for all or available qualifications. If set, code/name filters are ignored.

args.name: pageNumber
args.description: when not auto-fetching all, fetch a specific page (default 1)

args.name: autoFetchAllPages
args.description: truthy → fetch all pages (default true when all-mode)
